name: mode-migration
description: Migrate Mode (Mode Analytics / ThoughtSpot Mode) reports into Hex. This coding agent pulls the report via the Mode API and translates the Mode-specific layers (Liquid params, definitions, dataset refs, Python/R notebooks) into a migration brief; Hex's notebook agent builds a generative app on a natively-gated SQL data layer; then it's verified with a SQL-fidelity gate and a visual-QA loop.
